FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 8
Committee: Confirmations Sponsor: Senator Vivian Davis Figures
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 07/17/2023
Senate Bill 8 as introduced provides for the reapportionment and redistricting of Alabama's U.S.
Congressional districts. This bill will not affect state or local funding.
